name: Orenthil Whisperwind
summary: In Shadowglen, beneath Teldrassil’s boughs, Orenthil Whisperwind welcomes those setting out.

sections.title: A Friendly Face in Teldrassil
sections.body: Orenthil Whisperwind lives among the night elves in Shadowglen, beneath Teldrassil’s canopy. Little is known of his past.

faq.answer: Orenthil Whisperwind welcomes adventurers setting out beneath the World Tree. He is a night elf found in Shadowglen on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Where can I find Orenthil Whisperwind?
faq.answer: You can find Orenthil Whisperwind in Shadowglen, the night elf settlement within Teldrassil.
